extracted.intended_audience: USPTO-registered practitioners (patent agents/attorneys) and counsel handling reinstatement/disciplinary matters
extracted.subtask_short: petition for reinstatement to PTO practice
extracted.subtask_description: A petition submitted under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 requesting reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office; includes an affidavit and is decided by the Office of Enrollment and Discipline based on the petition, affidavit, and record information relevant to eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing a Petition for Reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: A Petition for Reinstatement must be submitted to the Office of Enrollment and Discipline (example: Petition of Stewart B. Myers received January 23, 2025).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The decision references receipt of a formal Petition for Reinstatement as the initiating document for consideration. The petition should be clearly dated and filed with the Office of Enrollment and Discipline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support with an Affidavit under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: The Petition should be accompanied by an affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 (the petitioner filed a supporting affidavit under that regulation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page explicitly notes an affidavit filed pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 in support of the petition, indicating that such an affidavit is an expected supporting document for reinstatement petitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review of Petition, Affidavit, and All Record Information Material to Eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligibility for reinstatement is determined after careful review of the petition, the supporting affidavit, and all information in the record material to the petitioner’s eligibility for reinstatement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The decision emphasizes that the Director conducts a comprehensive review of all record material relevant to eligibility; petitions are assessed on the full administrative record rather than any single document. Practitioners should ensure that all facts and supporting materials relevant to eligibility are included in the record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision Authority and Standard of Approval
rubrics_metrics.description: The Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline (Acting Director in this instance) determines whether reinstatement is appropriate and may grant the petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The document shows that the Director has the authority to grant reinstatement if, after review, reinstatement is deemed appropriate. The formal disposition is entered (e.g., 'Petition is hereby GRANTED'), with signature and date reflecting the official decision.
